title: Open follow-ups: unfixed findings and benchmark gaps (pending work, to do next)
what:
Pending, not yet fixed (known bugs):
- crates/anvil-cli/src/daemon/server.rs line 98: `Err(_) => {}` swallows accept() errors in the daemon loop. Real swallowed-error finding, still unfixed.
- Memory search bug: mem_search requires every query word to match, so natural queries ("known unfixed bug", "push to remote") return 0 hits. It should rank partial and fuzzy matches.
- Memory onboarding bug: mem_context and the SessionStart [anvil-memory] line show only decision records. User working rules, gotchas and open follow-ups (domain/gotcha kinds) never reach a fresh agent unless it searches for them.
- Slop benchmark known gaps:
  - no-commented-out-code;
  - TS/JS console.log debug leftovers (no-debug-helpers exists only for PHP);
  - a catch emptied by deleting its only statement.
- Extend the slop benchmark to Kotlin, Dart and GDScript, and turn real review_log findings into cases.
why: Two isolated-agent recall tests (2026-11-26) found every answer only after simplifying queries, and mem_context left out the onboarding records.
learned: Priority: the memory search and context fixes (they affect every agent), then the daemon accept() swallow, then the benchmark gaps. Lint, rule, exception, escape and anvil-allow all refer to the same mechanism.
author: reactive-end
